done: Your password is changed. Sign in with the new one.
@done: On the login screen, after a reset. The reset also signs the account out everywhere else.
explanation: Enter your account's email address. We'll send you a code to set a new password.
new_explanation: If an account uses this address, a code is on its way. Enter it with your new password.
@new_explanation: The server doesn't say whether the address belongs to an account, so this can't promise a mail.
@password_rule: Under the new password field. The server refuses shorter passwords.
